taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Search index/query authorization and stale document entitlements
controls.source_trace: Trace original document authority through index metadata into every returned hit/snippet/facet. Check whether caller-writable filters or stale ACLs substitute for current permission.
controls.implementation_branch: Map source object permissions into indexed fields, query filters and post-fetch checks, including snippets, facets and suggestions. A stale index entry is not necessarily readable if a final entitlement check rejects it. Use a synthetic permission change and record the effective propagation contract; classify count/snippet leakage separately from full content disclosure.
controls.controlled_verification: Use two owned synthetic documents and users; compare permitted search with a restricted document marker before/after entitlement removal.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A public title or aggregate count is not necessarily private content; establish the declared confidentiality of the observed signal.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind index/query output to current entitlement and verify snippets, exports, facets and deletion paths relevant to the finding.
